notes.title: Unreal engine GlitchPets update
notes.notes:
This build is made with unreal engine 5 early access. Everything seems to be going well, except imparting velocity when standing on fast moving objects seems disabled to me as a developer. That means the "space" levels in the 2d mode dont work properly. the the level Rat Rocket in the 3d mode has been disabled.

introducing mechanic: clipping/ghost
you can clip through very thin walls. This also adds two jumps to your total jump count, if used when you are out of jumps.

updated intro levels. After the apartment cutscene you now load into "Pond", which leads to tutorial_map_x

other stuff i did, but didn't document, and are now lost, yet present. 

Thanks for checking out the development process!

notes.title: Open Camera Update
notes.notes:
( + )You can now move the camera any which way!!!!!!!!! , except in Fall and Dodge.
( + ) added Jump to triggers of controllers , as well as zoom in and out of camera to shoulder buttons !!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
( + )Press Tab to see the old menu
Press Esc to see the new menu


++very curious to know how long it takes you to get through all the current content, what you think is amazing, or not. Has anyone found all of the chests so far? I think it's a lot easier with the new camera control. almost... too easy. But I'm liking it.  

Does the pacing seem just right? Too easy? not enough obstacles? Want enemies? want some attack moves? want an infinite enemy spawning increasing difficult zomby survival mode? Let me know your thoughts!

I'm considering lowering the price from $5 even though I feel Glitch Pets is already worth $10, and by release even more; however because there aren't many sales or reviews yet it makes me want to lower the price? Thoughts..?

Appreciate'Cha!
